description: This file defines an enum for attendance status and an immutable data model class for attendance records. It includes JSON serialization/deserialization, copying, and string representation methods, tailored for API interaction and internal handling within an attendance tracking system.

classes.name: AttendanceStatus
classes.description: An enumeration representing attendance states: present, absent, late, and excused, with utility methods for parsing from strings and converting to wire strings.

classes.name: Attendance
classes.description: An immutable model class encapsulating attendance record details, including identifiers, status, dates, notes, and metadata, with methods for JSON conversion, copying, and comparison.

methods.name: AttendanceStatus.fromString
methods.description: Creates an AttendanceStatus enum value from a string, ignoring case and whitespace; defaults to absent if input is unknown.

methods.name: AttendanceStatus.toWire
methods.description: Returns the string representation suitable for wire or API communication.

methods.name: Attendance.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create an Attendance object from a JSON map, handling flexible key names and date formats.

methods.name: Attendance.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Attendance object to a JSON map, with options for snake_case keys and ISO8601 date formats.

methods.name: Attendance.copyWith
methods.description: Returns a new Attendance instance with specified fields overridden.
